name: Alcohol
aliases: alcohol, ethanol, ethyl alcohol, ethanol of agricultural origin, alcohol etílico, alcohol de origen agrícola
what_is: A chemical compound produced by fermentation, also known as ethanol, used as an ingredient or solvent carrier.
why_botia: It flags it because it is strictly prohibited (haram) in Islamic dietary laws and is classified by the WHO as a Group 1 carcinogen that increases breast cancer risk in women even in small quantities.
can_1: Detect any alcohol or ethanol terms in the ingredients or product descriptions.
can_2: Provide cancer risk alerts for women and halal safety warnings.
cannot_1: Measure the exact volumetric or weight percentage of alcohol if it is present as a carrier residue below labeling thresholds.
cannot_2: Ascertain whether the alcohol was produced naturally via spontaneous fermentation or deliberately added.

sources.label: IARC Monographs on the Evaluation of Carcinogenic Risks to Humans
OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 General Requirements on Halal Food
